entry.title: Entrance gallery
entry.placementAndRenderPrompt: Retain the target camera and original openings of the double-height entrance. Keep the space open and the clear gallery doors light painted. Apply smooth pearl/putty greige walls, neutral pale matte oak flooring and smoky brown-oak storage. At the existing small storage location only, use one compact shallow curved-front credenza with two plain vertical-grain doors, short vertical polished-stainless pulls and a continuous curved plinth. Use the same accepted multi-drop cascade fixture in both cameras: CLEAR glass outer globes with visible inner bulbs, polished-silver fittings and the identical suspension layout. Do not substitute opaque opal globes in the reverse view. The small “Welcome Home” over the arch must be FLAT PAINTED lettering; the smaller “See you next time.” above the exit uses dimensional letters. Keep one refined blue/white artwork and a small plant. Do not add furniture in circulation, new ceiling trays, dark doors or a stair runner. The single credenza is at the under-stair niche in E1. Do not add a second credenza beside the front door in E2.
shellLocks: Keep the original arched single front door, its high circular window, the double-height arch, upper guard and actual side/gallery door positions.
Do not enlarge the entry or add a console to the middle of circulation. Preserve both source-camera sightlines.
entry.windowTreatment: Keep high round and stair-height glazing bare by default. Clear internal gallery doors remain clear. If the front door has exposed low glazing, assess actual street sightlines and use a purpose-made removable or fitted privacy solution only after measuring; do not frost all doors.

lighting.colorTemperature: 2700K decorative/lounge; 3000K useful task/general where stated. Physical fixture/color/dimmer approval required.
day: The same accepted clear-glass multi-drop chandelier, polished-silver fittings and visible inner bulbs are used in both views, with identical suspension layout. Confirm ceiling support, headroom, bulb/dimmer compatibility and installation access before selecting an actual retail fixture.
Separate chandelier dimming from existing recessed/general light. Provide practical low evening arrival light; do not use a glowing ceiling perimeter.
lighting.night: Use the same installed fixture inventory and room camera as the paired daytime view. Dim actual general/decorative/task groups naturally. Apply the room’s full privacy or blackout covering state; high bare glass and interior transoms remain as specified.
lighting.controlGroups: Provide the existing recessed-light circuit/group, one separately controllable decorative or task group where a fixture is actually specified, and a separate cabinet/display-light group only where needed. Avoid unnecessary ceiling work. A full fixture and switch schedule is required before rough-in.
